title: S8 figure-with-notes — one large image annotated with offset notes
idea: One large image with two or three short notes set beside it, each joined to the plate by a leader line. The band explains an object instead of presenting it.
why_new: every image in the catalog is either the whole band or one column of a split. Nothing annotates a picture, so a site whose subject is a thing — a press, a boat, a building — has no way to point at parts of it.
built_from: one wp:columns with the image column and a stack of short notes, plus one CSS hook for the leaders.
risk: the notes only look attached if they align to real features, which the pipeline cannot know from a generated or stock photograph — so the leaders must stay decorative and evenly spaced, never claim to point at a specific detail. Below the breakpoint the leaders must go.
